author: Anubhav Chaturvedi
scope: Complete coordinates and exact membership predicates; general boundaries have not been evaluated.
minimality: Local polytope has affine dimension8 and finite quotients preserve dimension; no PSD-order minimality claim.

local.domain: All probabilities>=0 and all eight CHSH expressions<=2; q<=lex T_g q for all128g.
local.face_strata: For every subset of the24 local facet inequalities (16 probability,8 CHSH): equality exactly on subset, strict otherwise; discard only infeasible strata by the exact formula.
local.seam_policy: Every beta=0 face is assigned here, including all tied CHSH facets.

cap.canonical_rule: lambda<=lex induced_permutation_h(lambda) for all16h preserving standardCHSH.
cap.tie_policy: Keep exactly one coordinate vector; record all residual isotropy elements. No tolerance tie breaking.
cap.zero_probabilities: For beta>0, winning event probabilities are positive; losing event i is zero iff lambda_i=0.

Bell_direction_atlas.canonical_rule: Take lexicographically least normalized cost vector among all transforms with strictlypositive standardPRcosts.

Bell_direction_atlas.exact_other_branch: Outside the union of the8strictPRcones, the NS maximizing face contains a deterministic behavior; Q1AB is exact.
Bell_direction_atlas.zero_objective: Trivial exact support0; no scale normalization.
